name: Cards of Prophecy
description:
About This Game

Cards of Prophecy combines Tower Defense, Deckbuilding, and Roguelike elements, with huge inspiration from Trading Card Games.

Build an ever evolving deck of spells and monsters. Fuse, defend, open card packs, create new strategies. Repeat.

🃏 BUILD YOUR DECK, CONQUER THE MAP 

Master an ever-evolving strategy on procedurally generated maps where no two runs are the same. Craft your ultimate deck from a vast roster of unique monsters and powerful spells to deploy on the battlefield.

⚡ THE POWER OF FUSION

The heart of your strategy lies in synergy. Thanks to the unique "Fusion" spell mechanic, combine two creatures to birth a hyper-powered hybrid monster with devastating effects. Master combinations to catch even the most fearsome bosses off guard!

🎁 OPEN BOOSTERS AND COLLECT

Use the gold earned during your runs to buy brand-new card packs in the shop. With over 100 unique cards to discover, every booster you open could unlock the missing piece to completely transform your playstyle. Collect them all to expand your future strategic options!

🐶 A COMPANION TO GUIDE YOU 

You won't face the prophecy alone. Your loyal four-legged companion, Charly, joins you on every adventure! The game features multiple game modes, each offering a completely different look for Charly.

📋 Key Features

  • Unique hybrid gameplay: The perfect marriage between tactical grid placement and explosive card combinations.

  • Dynamic fusion system: Combine two units to create a powerful hybrid monster; the order you fuse them changes the final creature!

  • Over 100 cards to collect: Discover a wide variety of unique monsters and powerful spells to customize your deck.

  • Roguelike progression: Face new challenges on procedurally generated maps with high replayability.
short_desc: Cards of Prophecy combines Tower Defense, Deckbuilding, and Roguelike elements, with huge inspiration from Trading Card Games. Build an ever evolving deck to summon monsters and use powerful spells. Fuse, defend, open card packs, create new strategies. Repeat.
